name: rapto
title: Rapto
description: Switch windows across desktops, apply layouts, change modes and open workspaces with Rapto, the window manager for macOS.
author: Levka

commands.name: switch-window
commands.title: Switch Window
commands.subtitle: Rapto
commands.description: Search all open windows on all desktops and jump to one instantly.

commands.name: apply-layout
commands.title: Apply Layout
commands.subtitle: Rapto
commands.description: Arrange the windows of the current desktop into a layout, or pick the layout for Drag to Snap.

commands.name: change-mode
commands.title: Change Mode
commands.subtitle: Rapto
commands.description: Switch the current desktop between Manual, Auto Tiling and Drag to Snap.

commands.name: open-workspace
commands.title: Open Workspace
commands.subtitle: Rapto
commands.description: Bring back the apps of a saved workspace into their places.
